Meet your physiotherapist

Care that sees the person, not just the condition.

I’m Areeba Hassan, a Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT), committed to supporting patients through thoughtful assessment, individualized rehabilitation, and clear patient education.

My clinical training has included musculoskeletal and neurological rehabilitation, therapeutic exercise, manual therapy techniques, functional assessment, and patient counseling.

A thoughtful approach

Small steps. Meaningful progress.

Good rehabilitation is collaborative. It starts by listening, understanding your movement goals, and building a plan around your individual needs.

  • ✓ Musculoskeletal rehabilitation
  • ✓ Neurological rehabilitation
  • ✓ Manual and exercise therapy
  • ✓ Gait training and mobility support
  • ✓ Posture correction and patient education
  • ✓ Electrotherapy techniques: IFT, TENS and ultrasound
See My Approach ↘
What to expect

A clear path, built around you.

Every person's needs are different. The process begins with a conversation and an assessment, then adapts to your goals and progress.

01

Listen & Understand

Talk through your concerns, daily activities, and what you hope to work toward.

02

Assess & Plan

Review relevant movement and functional needs to help shape an individualized plan.

03

Move & Practice

Work through appropriate therapeutic techniques and exercises with clear guidance.

04

Review Progress

Discuss progress and adjust the approach in line with your needs and clinical guidance.
